result.summary: Several layout and truncation issues make restaurant cards and category filters look broken or incomplete, plus a missing image on one popular item.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off in the Fastest near you row, so the full name is not readable.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or ensure cards have enough width/ellipsis with full name on tap so names are not clipped.

issues.description: Category filter chips overflow the screen edge on the right (partial 'Healthy' and a cut-off chip), with no clear indication of horizontal scroll.
issues.suggestion: Add visible scroll affordance, padding at the end of the chip row, or wrap/resize chips so none are clipped at the viewport edge.

issues.description: The second Popular right now card (pizza) shows the food image and -20% badge but has no restaurant name, delivery info, or rating below it—content appears missing or cut off by the bottom nav.
issues.suggestion: Ensure full card content (title, meta, rating) is visible above the tab bar and that images always load with fallback placeholders if needed.

issues.description: Fastest near you cards show only partial third item and tight spacing, making the horizontal list feel cramped and unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Increase card spacing/peek of the next card and consistent image aspect ratios for a cleaner carousel.

issues.description: Promo banner and some labels use dense text; delivery fees and times are clear but the clipped names reduce scannability of the list.
issues.suggestion: Prioritize full primary labels (restaurant names) over secondary meta when space is limited.
